title: Fluted Panel — one Math Engine, four flute profiles, shadow gap and a TV cutout
description:
A parametric FLUTED PANEL on the six-node spine — Geometry → Input Properties → Math Engine → Output Metrics → 2D Render + 3D Render.

DROP IT ON A SEGMENT. This is the plan's TV wall — a fluted run with a shadow gap at both ends and, optionally, a hole for the screen.

THREE OF THE FOUR PROFILES ARE THE SAME QUAD. A flute is a quad in plan swept up the wall: back edge on the backer, front edge at the flute depth. Square, Tapered and V-groove differ only in the front edge's half-width — `_frontR` is `_r`, `0.45·_r` or `0` — so they are one table with a different number in it, and V-groove collapsing to a point is a triangle the kernel already accepts.

HALF-ROUND IS THE SAME FLUTE SAMPLED. Each of `sides` slices spans an arc of the semicircle and is still one quad, so a faceted round flute takes the identical path as a square one rather than needing a lathe.

THE CUTOUT IS A SPLIT IN Z, NOT A SUBTRACTION. Flutes whose width overlaps the cutout are built as two bands, below it and above it. Flutes outside keep a full-height first band and a zero-height second one — one wasted row each, and in exchange the table keeps a single shape and there is no branch.

THE SHADOW GAP IS A REAL INSET. `_ru0 = _u0 + _sg` shortens the fluted run inside the panel, so the gap is a reveal rather than a flute that happens to be missing, and `runLength` reports what is actually fluted.

THE PITCH IS REDIVIDED, NOT TRUNCATED: `_pw = _run / round(_run / pitch)`, so the flutes always fill the run exactly and the requested pitch is a target. `actualPitch` reports what you got.

DIMENSIONS AT THE DEFAULTS: 2.032 × 2.972 m, 2.008 m of fluted run, 39 half-round flutes at 0.0515 m actual pitch, 0.036 m total depth.

WHAT THIS CANNOT DO. Flutes are vertical — a horizontal slat wall means hosting this on a segment turned on its side, which the object does not do for you. One cutout, rectangular, centred on the panel's length. The backer is a flat slab with no frame or battens.

props.name: Material
props.value: light oak veneer, matte lacquer, half-round flutes

props.name: Semantics
props.value: fluted timber feature wall, warm oak, vertical rhythm, contemporary hotel

params.name: Fluted Panel maths
params.expr:
_natL = length
# Host frame — node, segment or space
_e1 = hcat(1, 0)
_np = rows(P)
_isSeg = _np == 2
_isSpace = _np > 2
_edges = _isSpace ? (shift(P, -1) - P) : _e1
_edgeLen = len(_edges)
_longest = max(_edgeLen)
_spaceDir = _isSpace ? row(compress(_edges, eq(_edgeLen, _longest)), 0) : _e1
_segDir = _isSeg ? (row(P, 1) - row(P, 0)) : _e1
_dir = _isSpace ? _spaceDir : (_isSeg ? _segDir : _e1)
_dirLen = len(_dir)
_axisB = _dirLen > 0 ? normalize(_dir) : _e1
_rot = rotation * PI / 180
_crot = cos(_rot)
_srot = sin(_rot)
_bx = sub(_axisB, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_by = sub(_axisB, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_axisU = hcat(_bx * _crot - _by * _srot, _bx * _srot + _by * _crot)
_axisV = (flipSide > 0 ? -1 : 1) * perp(_axisU)
_ux = sub(_axisU, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_uy = sub(_axisU, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_vx = sub(_axisV, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_vy = sub(_axisV, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_Qu = col(P, 0) * _ux + col(P, 1) * _uy
_Qv = col(P, 0) * _vx + col(P, 1) * _vy
_hu0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qu) : 0
_hu1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qu) : 0
_hv0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qv) : 0
_hv1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qv) : 0
_hcu = (_hu0 + _hu1) / 2
_hcv = (_hv0 + _hv1) / 2
_hostL = _hu1 - _hu0
_hostW = _hv1 - _hv0
# Fit to host — one uniform scale, Max never enlarges
_availL = max(0, _hostL - 2 * margin)
_notOff = fitMode != 'Off'
_exact = fitMode == 'Exact'
_sRaw = _natL > 0 ? _availL / _natL : 1
_sFit = (_notOff && _availL > 0) ? (_exact ? _sRaw : min(1, _sRaw)) : 1
scale = max(0.15, min(5, _sFit))
_s = scale
_Ln = length * _s
_Ht = height * _s
_z0 = baseOffset
_z1 = _z0 + _Ht
_bk = backerThk * _s
_fd = fluteDepth * _s
_sg = shadowGap * _s
_Dtot = _bk + _fd
_bodyL = _Ln
_bodyW = _Dtot
# Anchor — place the footprint by any of the nine box points
_anchorL = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Left-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left'
_anchorR = anchorDir == 'Top-Right' || anchorDir == 'Right-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_anchorT = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Top-Center' || anchorDir == 'Top-Right'
_anchorB = anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_ax = _anchorR - _anchorL
_ay = _anchorB - _anchorT
_hau = _hcu + _ax * max(0, _hostL / 2 - margin)
_hav = _hcv + _ay * max(0, _hostW / 2 - margin)
_cu = _hau - _ax * _bodyL / 2
_cv = _hav - _ay * _bodyW / 2
_u0 = 0 - _Ln / 2
_u1 = _Ln / 2
_v1 = _Dtot / 2
_v0 = 0 - _Dtot / 2
_vb = _v1 - _bk
_BACK = hcat(_u0, _vb, _u1, _vb, _u1, _v1, _u0, _v1, _z0, _z1, 1)
# The flute run is inset by the shadow gap at both ends, so the gap is a real reveal and not
# a flute that happens to be missing.
_ru0 = _u0 + _sg
_ru1 = _u1 - _sg
_run = max(0.02, _ru1 - _ru0)
_pitch = max(0.008, flutePitch * _s)
_nf = max(1, round(_run / _pitch))
_pw = _run / _nf
_gp = min(fluteGap * _s, _pw / 3)
_r = (_pw - _gp) / 2
_fc = _ru0 + (arange(_nf) + 0.5) * _pw
# A CUTOUT IS A SPLIT IN Z, not a subtraction: the flutes that fall inside its width are built
# as two bands, below and above it. Flutes outside keep a full-height first band and a
# zero-height second one, which costs a row and keeps the table one shape.
_cw = min(cutoutWidth * _s, _run)
_ch = min(cutoutHeight * _s, _Ht)
_cc = cutoutCentre
_cz0 = max(_z0, _cc - _ch / 2)
_cz1 = min(_z1, _cz0 + _ch)
_cu0 = 0 - _cw / 2
_cu1 = _cw / 2
_inCut = cutout > 0 ? ((_fc + _r) > _cu0) * ((_fc - _r) < _cu1) : fill(_nf, 1, 0)
_zA1 = _z1 + _inCut * (_cz0 - _z1)
_zB0 = _z1 + _inCut * (_cz1 - _z1)
# Profile. Square, Tapered and V-groove are ONE quad each — only the front edge's half-width
# changes, so they are the same table with a different number in it.
_isRound = profile == 'Half-round'
_isSq = profile == 'Square'
_isTap = profile == 'Tapered'
_frontR = _isSq ? _r : (_isTap ? (_r * 0.45) : 0)
_vf = _vb - _fd
_S1a = hcat(_fc - _r, fill(_nf,1,_vb), _fc + _r, fill(_nf,1,_vb), _fc + _frontR, fill(_nf,1,_vf), _fc - _frontR, fill(_nf,1,_vf), fill(_nf,1,_z0), _zA1, fill(_nf,1,2))
_S1b = hcat(_fc - _r, fill(_nf,1,_vb), _fc + _r, fill(_nf,1,_vb), _fc + _frontR, fill(_nf,1,_vf), _fc - _frontR, fill(_nf,1,_vf), _zB0, fill(_nf,1,_z1), fill(_nf,1,2))
_SIMPLE = vcat(_S1a, _S1b)
# Half-round is the same flute sampled as `sides` slices of a semicircle. Each slice is still
# one quad — back edge on the backer, front edge on the arc — so it takes the identical path.
_ns = max(3, round(sides))
_M = _nf * _ns
_jf = kron(arange(_nf), ones(_ns, 1))
_js = kron(ones(_nf, 1), arange(_ns))
_cF = _ru0 + (_jf + 0.5) * _pw
_inC = cutout > 0 ? ((_cF + _r) > _cu0) * ((_cF - _r) < _cu1) : fill(_M, 1, 0)
_zRa = _z1 + _inC * (_cz0 - _z1)
_zRb = _z1 + _inC * (_cz1 - _z1)
_t0 = PI * _js / _ns
_t1 = PI * (_js + 1) / _ns
_ua = _cF + _r * cos(_t0)
_ub = _cF + _r * cos(_t1)
_va = _vb - _fd * sin(_t0)
_vbb = _vb - _fd * sin(_t1)
_R1a = hcat(_ua, fill(_M,1,_vb), _ub, fill(_M,1,_vb), _ub, _vbb, _ua, _va, fill(_M,1,_z0), _zRa, fill(_M,1,2))
_R1b = hcat(_ua, fill(_M,1,_vb), _ub, fill(_M,1,_vb), _ub, _vbb, _ua, _va, _zRb, fill(_M,1,_z1), fill(_M,1,2))
_ROUND = vcat(_R1a, _R1b)
_FLUTES = _isRound ? _ROUND : _SIMPLE
Q = vcat(_BACK, _FLUTES)
# Quad prism — every part is a quad swept from z0 to z1 (6 faces)
_nq = rows(Q)
_r4 = ones(4,1)
_a1 = col(Q,0)
_b1 = col(Q,1)
_a2 = col(Q,2)
_b2 = col(Q,3)
_a3 = col(Q,4)
_b3 = col(Q,5)
_a4 = col(Q,6)
_b4 = col(Q,7)
_qz0 = col(Q,8)
_qz1 = col(Q,9)
_gq = kron(col(Q,10), _r4)
_fq = kron(arange(_nq), _r4) * 6
_q0 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 0, _gq)
_q1 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 1, _gq)
_q2 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a1,_b1,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 2, _gq)
_q3 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 3, _gq)
_q4 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 4, _gq)
_q5 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 5, _gq)
_FL = vcat(_q0,_q1,_q2,_q3,_q4,_q5)
_PL = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_a2,_b2,_a3,_b3,_a4,_b4), 4*_nq, 2), kron(arange(_nq), _r4), _gq)
# Local (u,v,z) -> world, once, for every part at the same time
_U = _cu + col(_FL,0)
_V = _cv + col(_FL,1)
_W = hcat(_U * _ux + _V * _vx, _U * _uy + _V * _vy, col(_FL,2), col(_FL,3), col(_FL,4))
_nw = rows(_W)
_PU = _cu + col(_PL,0)
_PV = _cv + col(_PL,1)
_WP = hcat(_PU * _ux + _PV * _vx, _PU * _uy + _PV * _vy, col(_PL,2), col(_PL,3))
_nwp = rows(_WP)
Backer3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 1)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Flutes3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 2)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
BackerPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 1)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
FlutesPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 2)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
# Metrics
panelLength = _Ln
panelHeight = _Ht
topHeight = _z1
totalDepth = _Dtot
fluteCount = _nf
actualPitch = _pw
fluteWidth = 2 * _r
faceArea = _Ln * _Ht
cutoutArea = cutout > 0 ? (_cw * max(0, _cz1 - _cz0)) : 0
netArea = faceArea - cutoutArea
runLength = _run
facetCount = _isRound ? _ns : 1
